title: Survival Enchanted
description: A modpack which aims to completely revamp your survival experience while still keeping that vanilla vibe
body:
![survival enchanted logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dafd1d907cb426e50d207e20f9de55d724463d72.png)Survival enchanted aims to make progression more realistic, with needing to light campfires before using them, more realistic smelting, bigger villages and a collection of mods that will OVERHAUL your survival experience

# For the builders
Survival enchanted contains a lot of macaw's mods, so you can make your builds prettier and more detailed
# For the hunters
Better combat is added, allowing you to feel more immersed in the experience 
# For the aesthetic ones
Survival enchanted also comes with superdupervanilla, a good and not heavy shaderpack, and also a lot of texture packs that will make the sky prettier, animations more fluid and yeah will like not make everything so MONOTONE
